note: Positive relative improvements mean the forecast-driven policy holds fewer units on average, has fewer stockout days, or serves a higher share of demand than the naive seasonal policy. The planning driver is 70% of the p50 plus 30% of the p90: the conditional median of a zero-inflated series is often 0, so planning on the median alone would systematically under-stock intermittent SKUs. The blend keeps the median's stability while pricing the upside tail; it is the same signal used by Forecaster.recommend().

policy.average_on_hand: mean closing on-hand units across series-days
policy.order_up_to: expected (lead time + review period) demand + safety stock
policy.service_level_metric: 1 - stockout units / demand units (unit fill rate)
